description: Adopt Argo CD GitOps + External Secrets Operator at the manifest layer: vendor the three CRD JSON schemas and rewrite the poe k8s-check gate so the new CRD kinds are resolved (not silently skipped) durably in CI; add the deploy/argocd/ kustomization (two Application CRs + ClusterSecretStore, cluster-scoped, no namespace: transformer); add per-overlay ExternalSecret CRs and remove the obsolete SOPS caveat comment blocks; convert the migration Job to an Argo CD PreSync hook. This is the foundation FEAT: the schema gate and CRD validation must land before any later CRD-bearing manifest can be validated. Independent of the CI workflow (FEAT-003) but a prerequisite for the backup CronJob render (FEAT-002) and the docs (FEAT-004).
steps: Create deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/externalsecret_v1.json, clustersecretstore_v1.json, application_v1alpha1.json — each the published OpenAPI/JSON schema for that CRD. Filenames MUST match kubeconform's {{.ResourceKind|toLower}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json so one -schema-location dir resolves all three (API group intentionally omitted). Add deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/README.md recording provenance (datreeio CRDs-catalog or upstream openAPIV3Schema), apiVersions (external-secrets.io/v1, argoproj.io/v1alpha1), and the group-omission caveat.

Rewrite [tool.poe.tasks.k8s-check] in pyproject.toml to the two-pass form in design.md Quality-gate block: render dev/prod/argocd into a tmp dir; kubeconform pass (a) lenient over all three (-strict -summary -ignore-missing-schemas -schema-location default -schema-location 'deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/{{.ResourceKind|toLower}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json'); kubeconform pass (b) scoped to the CRD-bearing renders (argocd,dev,prod) with -ignore-missing-schemas REMOVED, -schema-location pointing ONLY at deploy/k8s/crd-schemas, core Kubernetes kinds excluded via -skip; kube-linter lint on dev/prod ONLY. Add a one-line comment above the task noting the schema-location template omits the API group.

Create deploy/argocd/application-dev.yaml (argoproj.io/v1alpha1 Application; metadata.namespace: argocd; spec.project: default; source.repoURL https://github.com/PLACEHOLDER_GITHUB_ORG/k8s-fastapi-starter.git; source.path deploy/k8s/overlays/dev; targetRevision HEAD; destination.server https://kubernetes.default.svc; destination.namespace fastapi-starter-dev; syncPolicy.automated {prune:true,selfHeal:true} + syncOptions:[CreateNamespace=true]).

Create deploy/argocd/application-prod.yaml — same shape, path deploy/k8s/overlays/prod, namespace fastapi-starter-prod, but OMIT syncPolicy.automated entirely (manual sync; no prune/selfHeal) while KEEPING syncOptions:[CreateNamespace=true]; document the single diff inline.

Create deploy/argocd/clustersecretstore.yaml (external-secrets.io/v1 ClusterSecretStore; metadata.name aws-secrets-manager; NO namespace; spec.provider.aws {service: SecretsManager, region: PLACEHOLDER_AWS_REGION}; auth omitted — rely on ESO controller SA IRSA; inline comment).
Create deploy/argocd/kustomization.yaml listing the three files in resources: with NO namespace: field.

Create deploy/k8s/overlays/dev/externalsecret.yaml and deploy/k8s/overlays/prod/externalsecret.yaml (external-secrets.io/v1 ExternalSecret; metadata.name app-secrets-external; spec.refreshInterval 1h; spec.secretStoreRef {name: aws-secrets-manager, kind: ClusterSecretStore}; spec.target.name app-secrets + creationPolicy Owner; spec.dataFrom[0].extract.key k8s-fastapi-starter/<env>/app-secrets).

In deploy/k8s/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml and prod/kustomization.yaml: add externalsecret.yaml to resources:; DELETE the 'BEFORE DEPLOY …' / 'secrets.<env>.yaml is intentionally NOT listed' comment blocks; replace with a short note that app-secrets is materialized by ESO from externalsecret.yaml and rotation is sops -> commit -> CI -> Secrets Manager -> ESO. Keep prod's existing patches/pdb reference.

In deploy/k8s/base/migration-job.yaml add metadata.annotations argocd.argoproj.io/hook: PreSync, argocd.argoproj.io/hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation, argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: '-1'; rewrite the header comment to describe the PreSync-hook lifecycle (hook recreated each sync via BeforeHookCreation; SHA-append dance gone; overlays still rename the Job per env). Keep spec/security/resources unchanged.

Run uv run poe k8s-check and confirm it passes: both kubeconform passes resolve Application + ClusterSecretStore (argocd render) and ExternalSecret (overlay renders) against the vendored schemas; kube-linter clean on dev/prod; confirm `kubectl kustomize deploy/argocd` emits the ClusterSecretStore with NO metadata.namespace and both overlays still show the Job renamed app-migrate-{dev,prod} with the three annotations and secretRef: app-secrets.
acceptance_criteria: uv run poe k8s-check exits 0 with the rewritten two-pass gate.
kubeconform pass (b) resolves (does not skip) Application, ExternalSecret, and ClusterSecretStore against deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/*.json; removing or mis-naming a vendored schema makes pass (b) fail.
kubectl kustomize deploy/argocd emits ClusterSecretStore with no metadata.namespace.

Both overlay renders contain a namespaced ExternalSecret (app-secrets-external, target.name app-secrets) and the migration Job carries the three Argo CD annotations and still references secretRef: app-secrets.
The old SOPS caveat comment blocks are gone from both overlay kustomization.yaml files.
verification: kubectl kustomize deploy/argocd | grep -c 'namespace:' (ClusterSecretStore block must not carry metadata.namespace — inspect output)
kubectl kustomize deploy/k8s/overlays/dev and .../prod render without error and include ExternalSecret + the annotated migration Job
findings: IMPORTANT kubeconform-0.8.0 quirk (deviation from design's Quality-gate block): the pinned kubeconform 0.8.0 provides NO toLower/lower/ToLower template function ('function "toLower" not defined'), so the design's '-schema-location deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/{{ .ResourceKind | toLower }}_{{ .ResourceAPIVersion }}.json' CANNOT be used as-written. Resolved by (a) naming the vendored files with CANONICAL kind casing (ExternalSecret_v1.json, ClusterSecretStore_v1.json, Application_v1alpha1.json — NOT lowercase) and (b) using the template WITHOUT the function: '{{ .ResourceKind }}_{{ .ResourceAPIVersion }}.json'. macOS FS is case-insensitive (lowercase would appear to work locally) but CI Linux is case-sensitive, so canonical casing is mandatory. Any later FEAT adding CRD schemas MUST follow the same canonical-casing convention. Schema provenance: datreeio CRDs-catalog main branch (raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main) — external-secrets.io/externalsecret_v1.json, external-secrets.io/clustersecretstore_v1.json, argoproj.io/application_v1alpha1.json; renamed to canonical kind casing on commit. Final k8s-check (pyproject.toml [tool.poe.tasks.k8s-check]) is the two-pass form: pass (a) lenient over dev/prod/argocd with -ignore-missing-schemas + -schema-location default + the vendored dir; pass (b) over argocd/dev/prod with -ignore-missing-schemas REMOVED, -schema-location ONLY the vendored dir, core kinds excluded via -skip (Namespace,ServiceAccount,ConfigMap,Secret,Service,Deployment,Job,CronJob,NetworkPolicy,PodDisruptionBudget,HorizontalPodAutoscaler); kube-linter on dev/prod only. Verified: pass (a) 18/18 valid; pass (b) resolves 5 CRs (2 Application + 1 ClusterSecretStore + 2 ExternalSecret), skips 13 core; negative test (mis-name a schema) makes pass (b) error. kube-linter 0.8.3 clean on dev/prod. ClusterSecretStore renders with NO metadata.namespace (deploy/argocd has no namespace: transformer). Both overlays render migration Job as app-migrate-{dev,prod} with the three Argo CD annotations and secretRef: app-secrets. NOTE for FEAT-002: -skip list already includes CronJob, so the backup CronJob needs no -skip change; backup-cronjob/backup-serviceaccount, networkpolicy 443 edit, docs/SPEC/ADR/placeholders were intentionally NOT touched by this FEAT. The ExternalSecret envFrom index: migration Job consumes secretRef at envFrom[1] (envFrom[0] is configMapRef app-config).
